hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'git (commit|push).*(--no-verify|-n )'; then echo '[hook] bloqueado: --no-verify contorna os gates do projeto' >&2; exit 2; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$'; then echo '[hook] TS alterado - rode o typecheck do pacote afetado antes de fechar'; fi

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then if git diff --cached | grep -nEi '(sk_live|whsec_|SERVICE_ROLE_KEY[^_]*=[A-Za-z0-9]|-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY)'; then echo '[hook] possivel secret no stage - revise antes de commitar' >&2; exit 2; fi; fi
